blocks.text: INDISPENSABLE TO A LEADER, USEFUL TO BOTH SIDES, NEVER SUSPECTED… ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT COHEN OR ABOUT THAT WOMAN?
I AM TALKING ABOUT HONG KONG. COHEN DID IT ALL HIS LIFE, WITH THE CHINESE, THE BRITISH, THE JAPANESE. PEOPLE CHANGE. THE METHOD DOESN'T.
IN HONG KONG, YOU DON'T CHOOSE YOUR SIDE. YOU CHOOSE YOUR GO-BETWEEN.
